launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.4 - LAUNCH ALWAYS UPDATES THE CLIENT FIRST. You can no longer play on an old Kinetrix Client. When you press LAUNCH, the launcher verifies the installed client against the update channel BEFORE the game is allowed to start: if a newer client was published it is downloaded right there (the progress card shows Updating Kinetrix Client with a live percentage, and the bar now gives the client download the space it deserves - it is the biggest file in the whole install) and the game starts only once the current client is verified on disk. If the update cannot be completed - a still-running Minecraft keeps the old jar locked, or a download keeps failing after 3 automatic retries - the launch is BLOCKED with the exact reason, and PLAY retries the moment the cause is fixed; the launcher never silently starts the game on an outdated client. Downloads are checksum-verified before they replace anything, an offline session still plays with the client already on disk (stated in the log), and the crash doctor's client-disabled safe mode is untouched. Everything from 3.0.3 is unchanged: all Minecraft versions with Forge or Fabric, Modrinth + CurseForge mod browser, Modrinth profile import, Microsoft sign-in, cosmetics locker, Linux game libraries and auto-update.

notes:
Kinetrix Client v3.15.0 - source protection release.

Every client build is now obfuscated: class, method and field names of the client's own code are renamed and repackaged, debug info stripped - the jar no longer decompiles to the original sources. Launcher compatibility, accounts, cosmetics and the website are fully preserved.

All old readable client releases were removed from the update channel; v3.15.0 is the only client distribution. This version also completes the rebrand: zero 'cloud' traces remain anywhere in the client.
